idea-plugin.name: Heph
idea-plugin.description: Language server integration for heph BUILD files. Starts heph tool build-lsp for BUILD files inside a heph repository and provides diagnostics, completion, hover, go to definition and formatting. Adds a "Heph" file type with syntax highlighting, a colour settings page, commenting, brace matching and quote handling. Requires an IDE with native LSP support (IntelliJ IDEA, GoLand and other 2026.3+ IDEs).
